# CC0Tree

Low-poly CC0 game-asset library by Skywolf Game Studios. Vendored from the public GitHub release.

- Site / GitHub: https://github.com/SkywolfGameStudios/CC0Tree
- itch.io: https://skywolfgamestudios.itch.io/cc0tree
- Retrieved: 2026-09-04
- Upstream commit: `eca825fc57443cc982eb0f8c40c1a10c6e5d1ecb` (2026-08-30)

## Files in this folder

| File | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `SM_Bowling_Ball.fbx` | Gameplay bowling ball |
| `SM_Bowling_Pin.fbx` | Gameplay bowling pin |
| `SM_TrashCan.fbx` | Optional alley dressing |
| `SM_Tree_Rounded.fbx` | Optional exterior / stylized dressing |
| `SM_Pine_Tree.fbx` | Optional exterior dressing |
| `SM_DeadPineTree.fbx` | Optional exterior dressing |
| `LICENSE` | CC0 1.0 Universal (copied from upstream) |

The rest of the CC0Tree library (tools, swords, etc.) was left upstream; grab more from GitHub if needed.
